videoDetails.title: Destiny 2 - How to get Salvagers Salvo (Legendary Grenade Launcher)
keywords: how to get salvagers salvo fast
videoDetails.shortDescription:
Salvager’s Salvo is a new breech-loading energy grenade launcher available as the pursuit weapon in Season of the Chosen. This weapon has some great perks, plus it comes fully master worked so you’ll want to add this to your list of objectives this season. Today I am going to look at how to get the weapon nice and quickly, plus a look at the perk combinations and how to increase the damage & range of the elemental explosions with a mod.
